_note: The 8 seed-pinned bench-shop findings of the Phase 5 offline corpus (W0-1), with the endpoints one failed attempt recorded (its evidence footprint). Built from saved trial data; no person data.

findings.title: Registration refuses an invalid email address
findings.expected: Anything else is refused with "Enter a valid email address."

findings.title: Change default delivery address, then place an order that uses it
findings.expected: Saving shows 'Saved.'; saved name and address become the account's details everywhere, including the next checkout's starting address.

findings.title: Saved delivery address is used at the next checkout
findings.expected: The default address is pre-filled and may be changed for this checkout only.

findings.title: Changed name and delivery address persist after reload and sign in again
findings.expected: After reloading /account the Default delivery address textarea shows 1 Test Road, York (requirement R-054)

findings.title: Registration refuses an invalid email address
findings.expected: The message Enter a valid email address. is shown next to the Email field (requirement 1.6)

findings.title: Account page shows the signed-in email and current details
findings.expected: Saving shows "Saved."; the saved name and address are the account's from then on, including the starting address of the next checkout.

findings.title: Saved name and delivery address persist after reload
findings.expected: After reload the delivery address textarea shows qamulx 9 Harbour Test Road, Leeds, and the account-linked checkout form shows the same address (requirement R-031)

findings.title: Registration refuses an invalid email address
findings.expected: The message Enter a valid email address. is shown under the Email field (requirement R-001.b)
